title: Max Tegmark: The Case for Halting AI Development | Lex Fridman Podcast #371
summary: Lex Fridman interviews MIT physicist Max Tegmark, co-founder of the Future of Life Institute, about the case for pausing giant AI experiments and the risks of advanced AI.
why: Recommended in AI-risk threads as a way to understand the safety-advocate argument for halting development.

quote.text: it's worth a watch just to be more prepared for where things are likely headed
